about_short_description.short_description: Djamo is a provider of financial applications that allow customers to use their cards with zero fees in a range of services.

product.name: Djamo Account and Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app that allows users to open a free account, manage finances, and access banking services including virtual and physical VISA cards.

product.name: Djamo VISA Card
product.description: A VISA card linked to the Djamo account for fee-free payments and cash withdrawals worldwide, including online and international use.

product.name: Djamo Savings Coffres (Côte d'Ivoire) / Poches (Senegal)
product.description: Automated savings compartments within the Djamo account that help users set goals and save money effortlessly with flexible deposits and withdrawals.

product.name: Djamo Money Transfers
product.description: A service enabling users to transfer money instantly and free to other Djamo accounts, or at low cost to Mobile Money and bank accounts within the UEMOA region.

product.name: Djamo Business Account
product.description: A business account solution allowing companies to manage payroll, bonuses, and expenses, and to issue discounted cards to employees.
